parts.html: The K-10 standard model is a striking loft-style furniture solution that brings together warm brown tones, wood texture, and the lightness of glass fronts. The combination of different materials and clean geometry creates a contemporary interior with a distinctive character.

The model’s main feature is the contrast between glass upper cabinets and lower fronts with wood-effect decor. The glass visually lightens the upper part of the kitchen, while the wood texture gives the furniture a natural, warm feel. This combination looks especially harmonious in loft interiors, modern apartments, and open-plan kitchen and living areas.

The L-shaped layout allows for an efficient workspace, placing the cooking zones, built-in appliances, and storage systems along two adjacent walls. At 5.2 linear meters long, the kitchen provides enough room for everyday tasks without the need for a separate island.

The compact laminate countertop supports the contemporary character of the furniture. Compact laminate has a dense structure and allows for sleek work surfaces that pair well with the wood and glass elements of the kitchen.
The upper fronts are made of glass, and the lower ones of laminated chipboard. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
A cargo pull-out is provided for storage. It conveniently holds food, kitchen utensils, and other items you want to keep close at hand.
Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms and concealed Muller Profi Line runners make the furniture comfortable to use. Furniture handles are included with the model.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-10 standard model can be adapted to the individual dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility lines and appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
We take a comprehensive approach to kitchen furniture: design development, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-10 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
